name: FireRisk Lite — Post-Fire Hazards
description: Módulo FireRisk compatível para risco pós-incêndio de cheias rápidas/enxurradas e deslizamento/erosão, alimentado por dados ICNF locais.

constraints.window_reference: current system date/time at request execution unless reference_date is explicitly supplied for testing
constraints.map_layer_policy: each burned area returned by the 12-month filter is rendered as an independent MapLibre source/layer pair
constraints.data_policy: uses ICNF records already fetched/stored locally by slow_data_fetching; cached KML/KMZ perimeters and cached analysis responses are used when available
